common: Production pixel art RPG sprite sheet. Exact 4 columns x 4 rows layout, uniform scale, feet baseline, generous gutters, crisp dark outlines and compact five-head proportions. Rows: front, right, back, left. Columns: idle, left stride with opposing arm, right stride with opposing arm, role-specific action. Request transparent background, opaque character interiors, no labels or scenery.
